description: Explains the concerted Diels–Alder [4+2] cycloaddition through diene conformation, orbital interactions and dienophile activation. Distinguishes endo/exo preferences, stereospecificity, enantiomer formation, regioselectivity and reversibility, and uses the ring disconnection in retrosynthesis.
